headline: Olavis Wake Flares as Gutter Flags Keep Turning
war_summary: Olavis Wake has leapt to the fore of the war's bloodiest fronts since our last edition, with better than fourteen hundred losses apiece in two hours and flags still turning at Iltaku as this report closed. Gutter's flag battle rages unabated — eighty-three changes on the day, seven in the past two hours — but its map has been redrawn: strongpoints once held five Wardens to one Colonial now stand two Wardens, three Colonials, two in no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse grinds on with fifty flag events on the day and its two ruined posts still unrebuilt, Spirit Watch the busiest ground. The Nevish Line, so costly at our last writing, has fallen nearly silent: flag work ceased hours ago and two-hour losses shrank to a few dozen. Fresh trade marks Pari Peak and Stlican Shelf's Breaker Town, while Marban Hollow's posts, though contested on the day, have gone quiet in the last two hours. Farranac Coast and Callahans Passage show no new flag movement yet pay steep ledgers. This is the war's 652nd day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
